How Much Does Shoulder Replacement Cost in Guadalajara, Mexico?

A typical shoulder replacement in Guadalajara is estimated at $8,500 to $11,500, depending on the procedure type, the surgeon, the hospital, the implant and what the package includes.

Travel, accommodation, physical therapy and other services may be billed separately, so request an itemized quote.

What affects the price?

  • Prosthetic design and implant brand used for the joint
  • Hospital tier and whether post-operative physical therapy is included

Most patients plan to stay roughly 10 to 14 days in the area and need the surgeon's travel clearance before flying home.

Before surgery expect imaging, blood panels, a cardiac assessment including an ECG, and an orthopedic exam.

Arrange a local orthopedic specialist or physical therapist at home before you travel and have your medical records translated.
